name: Winter Trophy Hold and Win

features.name: Medal Respin
features.description: A coin respin with a 5,000x jackpot.

review:
A winter-sports game where a tiger, fox, hare and penguin compete at skiing, skating, snowboarding and curling, with Coach Bear as the wild. 25 lines.

The Medal Respin works like Gold Respin, with a 5,000x jackpot for collecting enough coins, plus regular free spins. Very high volatility, a 5,624x max and 96.14% RTP. Another take on the Grand Mustang and Royal High-Road design.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
